rationale: For SOK 3.2.0 the Help matrix gives September 24, Kubernetes 1.32–1.37, Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. The linked change log gives September 8, Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. The queue reference change is scoped to Index & Ingestion Separation and the matrix directs operators to upgrade SOK first. The change log labels General Terms acceptance as the earlier 3.0.0 transition.

exclusions: No universal Kubernetes maximum, Enterprise 11.x compatibility, app pairing, Cloud availability or authorization is established.

remainingConcerns: Check for an official reconciliation before treating a disputed tuple as supported.
